title: Implement signed generator action from endpoint checkpoints and retain its positive-support limit
statement: Complete acquired checkpoints and native endpoints implement an unbiased signed local generator action with finite expected work. A universal nonnegative direct-rate estimator or positive native-jump sampler is impossible under the general endpoint-only interface.

evidence.range_scope: Full restorable-state and certified-rate access, signed branching inverse and precise positivity obstruction.

requires: The interface supplies a complete Markov state, retention and restoration of initial or previously returned checkpoints, native evolution for a requested duration with fresh independent future randomness, endpoint equality, bounded terminal observable f, known intervention weights, and a certified global exit-rate ceiling R. The theorem permits finite or countable bounded-rate state spaces. Hidden ages, promoter states, pending events or other memory cannot be omitted. The ceiling is earned from model constraints, not inferred from unrestricted finite observations.
For the nontrivial construction use finite positive R, mu=5R, independent exponential durations and fresh native continuations. Every tree origin is an initial or previously returned checkpoint.
provides: For P=E exp(tau Q)=mu(mu I-Q)^-1, the resolvent identity is Q=mu(I-P^-1). This identity is established machinery; the source constructs its local signed operation without full-matrix inference.

At signed node (z,a), advance to y. If y=z, stop. Otherwise add mu*a*(delta_y-delta_z), then spawn (z,a) and (y,-a). Aggregate repeated labels. The returned row Gamma has E Gamma=Q(x,.). Branch probability <=R/(mu+R)<=1/6 gives expected nodes <=3/2.

The source compares a three-state directed cycle without 0->2 to one with that edge. Finite adaptive endpoint transcripts have mutually absolutely continuous laws. Almost-sure termination and nonnegative unbiasedness would force a direct-rate estimate to vanish in both models, a contradiction. The same support obstruction rules out universal exact positive native-jump/uniformized microscopic sampling.
assumptions: The obstruction concerns direct rates/native jumps, not every positive sampler of a perturbed positive-time endpoint distribution.
Complete state and global rate ceiling are supplied access. A software checkpoint is not an unknown physical specimen that can be cloned or reset.
costs: All endpoint calls, native durations, complete checkpoint storage/copying, state comparison, sparse aggregation and signed moments are counted. The global rate ceiling can grow with system size.
contract.units: R and mu are rates; Gamma is a signed generator row in rate units; state restoration is complete Markov-state restoration.
contract.obstruction: The global R may grow with system size. The response scale R^2 T^2 and exponential finite-strength variance can make long or strong interventions expensive. Checkpoint copying, arithmetic, storage, physical evolution duration and rare-event relative precision remain resources. Endpoint laws identify aggregate state-transition rates, not selectively hidden mechanisms sharing a transition. Multiplicative edits cannot invent an absent reaction. A physical material change need not obey the specified edge multipliers. Positive sampling of native jumps is obstructed in the general class; the theorem does not rule out every positive sampler of perturbed positive-time endpoints.

body: The producer reports an unchanged GillesPy2 SSA interface in a separate process. No held implementation, proof, raw sample or audit original is acquired or executed by Capital.
